daily.today_energy: Your vibe is expansive and curious today. There's a restless energy pushing you to explore new perspectives and break free from routine. Lean into it—your intuition is particularly sharp right now.
daily.love: Connection feels lighter and more playful. If you're coupled up, try doing something spontaneous together. Single? Your openness is magnetic. Someone might catch your eye in an unexpected place.
daily.career: Ideas are flowing, but resist the urge to chase every shiny opportunity. Focus your fire on one meaningful project. Your ability to see the bigger picture is your superpower today—use it strategically.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and fresh air. A walk, dance session, or outdoor adventure could shift your entire mood. Notice what makes you feel alive and prioritize that energy over perfection.

weekly.love: Venus is whispering something about vulnerability being your superpower rn. Whether you're single or coupled up, honesty about what you actually need opens doors. Don't overthink the small stuff; your vibe speaks louder than your words.
weekly.career: Your ambitious energy is peaking, but the universe is asking you to zoom out before zooming in. Big picture thinking pays off this week. Collaboration over solo plays brings the most unexpected wins. Trust your instincts on new opportunities.
